description: Convert JSON to YAML 1.2 or YAML to JSON. Optional indent (2 or 4), sort keys (JSON to YAML), and pretty-printed JSON (YAML to JSON). Duplicate YAML keys are rejected. Input is not stored.

indent.description: For to_yaml, spaces per indent, default 2

name: json_to_yaml
title: Convert JSON to YAML, or YAML to JSON
